name: Irei Mizuka
source:
Misaki's best friend. She wears a HUG, a power-assisted suit for mobility after her legs were paralyzed.

[spoiler]After Kimijima was killed she discovered the body and hid it, which resulted in Misaki not being blamed for the murder. She dies when her HUG is driven berserk by the Committee of 300 and she falls off a cliff.[/spoiler]
